credentials stuffing: It relies on a simple human flaw: reusing the same login credentials across different accounts.   
APT=*Advanced Persistent Threat* (Menace Persistante Avancée), une cyberattaque complexe et prolongée.

Spear Phishing: A highly personalized email or message that targets a specific individual or organization, often researching the victim’s job title, name, and employer to build trust.

Whaling: A highly targeted attack aimed specifically at C-suite executives, directors, or other high-profile, high-privilege targets ("big fish") to steal large sums of money or highly sensitive data.

Vishing: Short for "voice phishing," this occurs when scammers use phone calls or voice messages to trick victims into revealing sensitive information or authorizing transactions.

Smishing: Short for SMS phishing, this involves sending malicious text messages containing suspicious links or urgent requests to a mobile device
